description: DramaBox is an English expressive TTS and voice-cloning model packaged for audio.cpp as a standalone GGUF bundle. It combines Gemma text conditioning, diffusion sampling, reference-audio conditioning, long-form chunking, and 48 kHz stereo output.

request.name: target_voice
request.description: Reference voice WAV path for voice cloning. If omitted, DramaBox generates from text without reference-audio conditioning.

request.name: negative_prompt
request.description: Negative text conditioning used when guidance_scale enables classifier-free guidance; omitted uses the built-in quality prompt.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Explicit target duration in seconds; default 0 uses the prompt-duration estimator.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Diffusion sampling step count; default comes from config.json, 30 in the current package.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 2.5 in the current package. Values greater than 1 enable CFG.

request.name: spatio_temporal_guidance_scale
request.description: Spatio-temporal guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 1.5 in the current package. Values greater than 0 enable STG.

request.name: duration_scale
request.description: Multiplier applied to the estimated prompt duration when duration_sec is 0; default comes from config.json, 1.1 in the current package.

request.name: reference_duration_sec
request.description: Reference voice crop/repeat duration in seconds; default comes from config.json, 10.0 in the current package.

request.name: guidance_rescale
request.description: Guidance rescale value. The default auto mode derives a rescale value from guidance_scale; a numeric string requests an explicit value.

request.name: audio_chunk_threshold_sec
request.description: Estimated duration threshold that switches a request to long-form chunking; default 45.0 seconds.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Target estimated duration for each long-form chunk; default 37.0 seconds.

request.name: cross_fade_duration_sec
request.description: Equal-power cross-fade between long-form chunks in seconds; default 0.05.

request.name: seed
request.description: Torch-compatible CUDA noise seed for diffusion sampling; default 42.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Attention implementation mode. Default off keeps the exact reference-query attention path; flash_attention enables the optimized path.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs and weights immediately after each request phase to reduce peak and resident VRAM; default false keeps components cached for later reuse.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

description.en: DramaBox is an English expressive TTS and voice-cloning model packaged for audio.cpp as a standalone GGUF bundle. It combines Gemma text conditioning, diffusion sampling, reference-audio conditioning, long-form chunking, and 48 kHz stereo output.
description.zh: DramaBox 是面向 audio.cpp 以独立 GGUF 包提供的英语表现力 TTS 与音色克隆模型。融合 Gemma 文本条件、扩散采样、参考音频条件、长文本分块与 48 kHz 立体声输出。

target_voice.en: Reference voice WAV path for voice cloning. If omitted, DramaBox generates from text without reference-audio conditioning.
target_voice.zh: 音色克隆用的参考 WAV 路径。省略时不带参考音频条件，直接由文本生成。

negative_prompt.en: Negative text conditioning used when guidance_scale enables classifier-free guidance; omitted uses the built-in quality prompt.
negative_prompt.zh: 当 guidance_scale 启用无分类器引导时使用的负向文本条件；省略时使用内置质量提示。

duration_sec.en: Explicit target duration in seconds; default 0 uses the prompt-duration estimator.
duration_sec.zh: 显式目标时长（秒）；默认 0 表示使用提示时长估计。

num_inference_steps.en: Diffusion sampling step count; default comes from config.json, 30 in the current package.
num_inference_steps.zh: 扩散采样步数；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 30。

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 2.5 in the current package. Values greater than 1 enable CFG.
guidance_scale.zh: 无分类器引导强度；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 2.5。大于 1 时启用 CFG。

spatio_temporal_guidance_scale.en: Spatio-temporal guidance scale; default comes from config.json, 1.5 in the current package. Values greater than 0 enable STG.
spatio_temporal_guidance_scale.zh: 时空引导强度；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 1.5。大于 0 时启用 STG。

duration_scale.en: Multiplier applied to the estimated prompt duration when duration_sec is 0; default comes from config.json, 1.1 in the current package.
duration_scale.zh: duration_sec 为 0 时，作用于估计提示时长的倍率；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 1.1。

reference_duration_sec.en: Reference voice crop/repeat duration in seconds; default comes from config.json, 10.0 in the current package.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 参考语音的裁剪/重复时长（秒）；默认取自 config.json，当前包为 10.0。

guidance_rescale.en: Guidance rescale value. The default auto mode derives a rescale value from guidance_scale; a numeric string requests an explicit value.
guidance_rescale.zh: 引导重缩放值。默认的 auto 模式根据 guidance_scale 推导；传入数字字符串则使用显式值。

audio_chunk_threshold_sec.en: Estimated duration threshold that switches a request to long-form chunking; default 45.0 seconds.
audio_chunk_threshold_sec.zh: 切换到长文本分块的估计时长阈值；默认 45.0 秒。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Target estimated duration for each long-form chunk; default 37.0 seconds.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 每个长文本分块的目标估计时长；默认 37.0 秒。

cross_fade_duration_sec.en: Equal-power cross-fade between long-form chunks in seconds; default 0.05.
cross_fade_duration_sec.zh: 长文本分块间的等功率交叉淡入淡出（秒）；默认 0.05。

seed.en: Torch-compatible CUDA noise seed for diffusion sampling; default 42.
seed.zh: 扩散采样用的 Torch 兼容 CUDA 噪声种子；默认 42。
